answer.rationale: Incumbent already refused a price reopen, so renew/negotiate cannot hit the 18% spend cut; deferral is unsafe because the primary contract ends in 14 days with no auto-renew and the line has no buffer. The low-cost quote is the only path that meets the mandate. c2 reports a prior primary move to that vendor with fast onboarding and clean invoicing, which is why switch is the current intent—but c2 does not establish delivery continuity at 94% utilization, while c1 is the only record of uninterrupted scheduled deliveries. Those two archives need to be checked before treating historical onboarding speed as evidence that delivery risk will not rise. Second-source would not replace the expiring primary in a single decision.
